scope: Additional real GOWT1 held-out-sequence denoising comparison through normal isolated adapters; not calibrated low-light evidence or universal improvement.
diameter_selection: Median of normal Cellpose3 nuclei size-model estimates on all 20 raw training-sequence frames, fixed for every evaluation arm before held-out predictions. No evaluation image, gold label or score is used for selection.
scoring_policy: For each predicted mask, retain complete object pixels if any pixel intersects [50:-50,50:-50]; exclude only wholly exterior predicted objects. Compare full retained masks to all 24 gold masks. Object IoU/Hungarian F1 is our paired benchmark, not an official CTC SEG/DET/TRA score.
limitations: Only one held-out sequence and four nearby timepoints; these are not four independent biological replicates.
The dataset page does not establish calibrated low-light acquisition or photon counts; no low-light ground-truth claim is made.
Gains or losses on this dataset do not establish a universal denoising benefit.
